context.stage: WF-03 Step Final — git-merge ISS-0071 fixes

task.description:
WF-03 Step Final (fn:git-merge): Create PR and merge feature/WF03-uat-onboarding-realm-sync-20260616 into main.

fn:git-merge:
  git fetch origin main
  git rebase origin/main  (resolve conflicts if any)
  git push origin feature/WF03-uat-onboarding-realm-sync-20260616
  gh pr create --base main --title 'fix(WF03): onboarding realm-sync guard + pipeline slug injection (ISS-0071)' --body 'Fixes two root causes identified in UAT run WF05-swiftroute-onboarding-gui-20260616 ISSUE-EO003:\n\n**Fix A** — Pipeline test slug injection: env vars ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG and ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_ADMIN_USERNAME allow UAT-RUNNER to inject scenario canonical values into the onboarding wizard Playwright test.\n\n**Fix B** — Realm-existence guard: GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id now probes Keycloak when state=completed. If the realm is missing, the record is transitioned to state=failed (error=realm_missing) preventing Alice from seeing a false success screen.\n\n3/3 integration tests pass. All unit tests pass.'
  gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
  git checkout main
  git pull --ff-only origin main

Return: PR URL, merge commit SHA, branch status.
acceptance_criteria: Local repo on main with clean state
